$comment: A history DESCRIPTION, not a repository. fixtures/scan-canary cannot carry a nested .git, so
bin/lib/provenance-fixture.mjs materialises these steps into a temporary git repo (real
commits, real identities, a real --no-ff merge) before bin/commit-provenance.mjs runs over it.
Every identity is synthetic: example.test addresses, names that belong to nobody.
What it plants, and which rule each feeds:
- a commit whose author and committer are two different humans -> author-committer-mismatch
- a commit authored by dependabot[bot] with no bot registered -> machine-author-unregistered
- a merge commit authored by that bot with no 'authorized by' marker -> bot-authored-merge
- requireSigned on the default branch while every commit is unsigned -> unsigned-on-protected-branch

steps.message: rebased onto main by a second maintainer
